title: Kenworth T608 FUPS High Tensile Bullbar #30
description: Kenworth T609 FUPS hi-tensile aluminium Bullbar. Lower cow catcher bar at the base of the main channel with 5 small uprights. 88mm pipe with an additional lower tube in front of the grille plus a full width additional cross pipe above headlights. All cross pipes are recessed into the drilled uprights, no butt welds. The heavy duty box uprights extend across the main channel to the cow catcher bar for maximum strength and protection. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Bug mesh fitted to lower area of the grill. Indicator repeater lights recessed into main channel. Main bumper channel is contoured to match the T608 body lines with heavy duty return panel to match mudguard contour.
